issues.issue: The phase citation references study C2302 ('The Phase 3 study... C2302, is still ongoing'), which is a different, ongoing trial, not the pivotal C2301; it does not support C2301 being Phase 3.

The '12-week open-label dose titration', '12-week open-label maintenance', and 'four periods' details are not supported by the citations, which only state a 48-week Core Period and an 8-week Period 3 randomized withdrawal.
Uncited numbers '12' (x2) and '4' in the design text describe period durations/count not present in any citation quote.
The parenthetical 'Week 34' is not contained in the endpoint citation (which references the end of the 8-week Period 3, not a numbered week).
Trial identified as C2301, but the pivotal efficacy/safety citations come from a separate document (d99ce1c1) that does not name the study, creating potential ambiguity with C2302.

Uncited numbers '10' (>10% threshold), '48' (week), and '137' (N) appear in text but are contextual/framing values not in the AE-rate citation; N=137 is corroborated by the trial n field citation, so acceptable.
Flagged uncited numbers '7'/'2019' are the receipt date (3/7/2019), which is a date and cited elsewhere in receipt_date; false-positive flag.
Flagged uncited '3' values are part of the receipt date March 7, 2019, which is a date and cited in receipt_date; false-positive flag.
value=true is correctly inferred from absence of a prior CRL (crl_history.prior_crl=false); no issue, noted per instructions.
